from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792485222/attempts/83275b2e45034ad1868f4c57ede5090a/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''from collections import deque

def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    background = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == background or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    ny, nx = y+dy, x+dx
                    if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and (ny,nx) not in seen and grid[ny][nx] == color:
                        seen.add((ny,nx)); q.append((ny,nx))
            r0, r1 = min(y for y,x in cells), max(y for y,x in cells)
            c0, c1 = min(x for y,x in cells), max(x for y,x in cells)
            if r1-r0 < 2 or c1-c0 < 2:
                continue
            perimeter = {(y,x) for y in range(r0,r1+1) for x in range(c0,c1+1) if y in (r0,r1) or x in (c0,c1)}
            if not all(grid[y][x] == color for y,x in perimeter):
                continue
            if not all(grid[y][x] == background for y in range(r0+1,r1) for x in range(c0+1,c1)):
                continue
            fill = 7 if (r1-r0 == 2 and c1-c0 == 2) else 2
            for y in range(r0+1,r1):
                for x in range(c0+1,c1):
                    out[y][x] = fill
    return out
'''
path=program_dir/'task-9ef55985.py'
path.write_text(code)
exec(compile(code, str(path), 'exec'))
